source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Connect BMC Shared port
2. Check BMC netwrok and MAC from Web UI and IPMI OOB "lan print" and check if BMC has only one Bounded LAN chanel
3. Remove BMC Shared port, check BMC network and MAC from Web UI and IPMI OOB command "lan print"
4. Plug BMC Shared port , check BMC network and MAC from Web UI and IPMI OOB command "lan print"
5. To check BMC can display in POST Page.
Optional : 
1. To do WOL in S5, when using sharenic BMC. 

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test
    3. To check BMC IP can display in POST Page
    4. To check WOL successfully and BMC is alive
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. BMC should have same network configuration include IP and MAC in three scenarios
2. BMC network should work in three scenarios
3. DHCP and Static IP should display correctly

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: this checks the shared NIC keeps one bound LAN channel across three scenarios (connect, remove, replug) of the BMC shared port. Unplugging/replugging the shared-port cable between scenarios is physical work only a person at the machine can do.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator connects/removes/replugs the BMC shared port and confirms network+MAC stay consistent in each scenario; agent could only read `ipmitool lan print` channel count after the operator switches cabling.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED due unexplained reachability while shared cable is absent and mixed POST/WOL scope.

original_test_intent: Validate shared-NIC binding across connected/disconnected/reconnected states plus POST display and optional WOL, but the required reachability during cable absence has no defined alternate path.
original_method: An engineer changes physical shared-port cabling while network, MAC/channel, POST and optional WOL evidence is observed.
manual_activity: After source correction, an engineer controls cabling and observes POST; the agent may collect per-state network and WOL evidence.
required_inputs: Expected reachability when shared cable is absent
safety_requirements: Do not infer a hidden alternate path from continued reachability.
Use isolated labeled networks and prevent loops/duplicate IPs.
Maintain local/OOB recovery; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, collect per-state interface, route, MAC/IP, reachability and optional WOL evidence.
Do not recable, observe POST or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve topology/scope, perform physical scenarios and observe POST.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Physical limitation is correct but does not resolve disconnected-state semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No execution until reachability path and POST/WOL scope are defined.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All connect/remove/replug, one-channel, POST, optional WOL and 10/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define topology and expected path per state, then recable with path-specific probes, verify binding and separately record POST/WOL if in scope.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes disconnected path and separate scopes explicit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents unexplained alternate connectivity from passing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Mis-cabling can create loops or lose management.

project_override_considerations: A project alternate path must be explicit and cannot silently resolve Master Source ambiguity.
expected_evidence: POST and optional WOL evidence if selected

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure removes the shared port, while Criteria require the BMC network to work in all scenarios without defining a dedicated/alternate path; POST and optional WOL add unaligned acceptance scopes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Reachability during physical disconnection may mean failover or may be impossible; choosing by inference tests a different topology and cannot yield valid acceptance.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines the path/scope decision and loop safety.

review_improvement: Requires every observed response to be attributed to the intended shared or alternate path.
independent_technical_reasoning: If the only shared link is unplugged, successful access must traverse another interface; without defining that path, both success and failure are uninterpretable.
